name: nora-store
description: NORA 3C e-commerce monorepo · 极简 Apple 风门店前端 + FastAPI AI 客服后端

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test:api: cd ecommerce-ai-customer-service && if not exist .test-tmp mkdir .test-tmp && set TMP=%CD%\.test-tmp && set TEMP=%CD%\.test-tmp && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=.test-tmp\pytest-root
scripts.test: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run test:web" "npm run test:api"
